Shape the Conversation

Inside the Story: A Conversation on Border Journalism and Source Protection

California Western School of Law’s New Media Rights Clinic presents "Inside the Story: A Conversation on Border Journalism and Source Protection." This event offers an in-depth exploration of investigative reporting, digital security, and the legal challenges involved in covering the U.S.-Mexico border.

Register Here

CWSL All-Alumni Reunion 2026

Join us on Thursday, October 8, 2026, for the CWSL All-Alumni Reunion, an evening dedicated to reconnecting with classmates, expanding your professional network, and celebrating the lifelong connections that begin at California Western School of Law. The reception begins at 5:00 p.m. at the Kona Kai San Diego Resort, where alumni from every graduating class are invited to come together for an evening of conversation, camaraderie, and community.

Our Programs

Earning a law degree from California Western means mastering legal theory and fundamentals, honing critical-thinking skills, and gaining the ability to apply the law in dynamic settings. For more than 100 years, California Western has succeeded in helping law students gain the skills and experience that employers and clients seek.
